cmake_minimum_required( VERSION 3.10 FATAL_ERROR )

project( "openxr-main" LANGUAGES CXX )

set( BUILD_TESTING 				OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( BUILD_TESTS 				OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( BUILD_ALL_EXTENSIONS 		OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( BUILD_FORCE_GENERATION 	OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( BUILD_SPECIFICATION	 	OFF CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )

set( BUILD_ALL_LAYERS 			ON  CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( BUILD_LOADER 				ON  CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )
set( DYNAMIC_LOADER				ON  CACHE INTERNAL "" FORCE )

set( AE_EXTERNAL_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." )
include( "${AE_EXTERNAL_PATH}/config.cmake" )

add_subdirectory( "OpenXR-SDK-Source" )
